meta_description: 665 likes, 9 comments - chrisburkard on September 24, 2026: "The internet is ruthless when it comes to flubbing a scene in any image or video. They WILL notice, and they WILL call it out. It’s embarrassing for the photographer, the crew, and any brands involved. Generally speaking, it can be a death knell for a campaign or even an entire brand. Fortunately, there are easy ways to make sure that what your shooting is set up for success and building your scene properly is the biggest one. I touch on some of my thought process and considerations when it comes to scene building in photography in my latest and final episode of “Inside ‘Out There’” with my friends @sonyalpha. You can now view the full 6 part series on YouTube. Enjoy.".
